Faceless AI affiliate marketing is the easiest model to start as a beginner, and it's not close.

Every other route asks for something before you begin. Dropshipping wants stock. An agency wants clients. Coaching wants a product and a face. Each one is a reason to put it off another week.

This one asks for a laptop.

How it works:

1. Pick an AI tool you already use. Join its affiliate program.
2. Record your screen showing it do the thing.
3. Post every day. One format, repeated.
4. Get paid every month they stay.

And that last word is the important one. A pay-once offer is a single bar in month one. A monthly offer stacks — the post you made in month one is still paying in month twelve.

Comment SYSTEM and the full blueprint is in your DMs.
